# Ovinia
Ovinia are a species of ruminant-like humanoids scattered across the Ring of Bones, a trio of shadowy moons orbiting a ringed gas giant. Uaalia is the largest and most hospitable moon, while forested Luani and fungus-dominated Iita remain highly isolated and full of deadly predators.
## Species Traits - Damage Weaknesses: Slash and Pierce +15% - Herbivore Diet: Can only eat fruits and vegetables, flowers, grains, and the odd banana peel as a little treat - Animal Stomach: Poisoned by theobromine (tea, chocolate), caffeine (coffee, energy drinks), and allicin (garlic, onions) - Grazing Habit: Finish food and drinks 40% slower - Sleepy and Docile: Forced sleep effects last for twice as long, but can fall asleep anywhere - Animal Friend: Mild manner soothes domesticated animals - Temperature Tolerance: Fluffy wool coat insulates like a winter coat - Prey Adrenaline: Initially speed up upon taking damage, but slow down quicker when the damage gets too severe - Sturdy Hooves: Can safely walk "barehoofed" on broken glass and similar hazards
## Naming Traditions
Ovinia culture lacks gendered names or pronouns. They favor long, flowy names with soft consonants and extended vowels, but will usually shorten them to first syllables in more casual settings. First names are often abstract, named after concepts or virtues, while last names are used to differentiate flock lineages. Uaalian ovinia seeking to blend into a new, larger flock have taken to adopting the naming conventions of other species.
- Mera Phaelarune - Lethaavul Rhymehelai - Baareivelaa Vylune - Ruth Lyvahlia - Thallinn Mehhvaa
